english_text: Warm up before exercising and cool down afterwards.
sesotho_text: Itokisetse pele ho itlama mme o khutse ka mor'a moo.

english_text: Drink water before, during, and after exercise.
sesotho_text: Noa metsi pele, nakong, le ka mor'a ho itlama.

english_text: Wear comfortable and supportive footwear when exercising.
sesotho_text: Apara lieta tse lokelang le tse tshehetsoang ha o itlama.

english_text: Avoid exercising in extreme heat to prevent heat exhaustion.
sesotho_text: Hana ho itlama mochesong o feteletseng ho thibela ho lapala ha mocheso.

english_text: Listen to your body and rest if you feel pain during exercise.
sesotho_text: Mamela 'mele oa hao mme o khutse haeba o ikutloa mahloko nakong ea ho itlama.

english_text: Consult your doctor before starting a new exercise programme.
sesotho_text: Buisana le ngaka ea hao pele ho qala lenaneo le lecha la ho itlama.

english_text: Exercise is safe and beneficial for most people with chronic conditions.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho bolokehile mme ho na le molemo ho batho ba bangata ba nang le maemo a tsoelang pele.

english_text: Physical activity is recommended for people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e khothaletsoa bakeng sa batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Exercise helps people with TB regain their strength during recovery.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho thusa batho ba nang le TB ho khutlisa matla a bona nakong ea ho fola.

english_text: Physical activity supports mental health and reduces stress.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e tshehetsa bophelo ba kelello le ho fokotsa khatello ea maikutlo.

english_text: Reduce the amount of time you spend sitting each day.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa nako eo o e sebelisang o lula letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Take short breaks to stand and move during long periods of sitting.
sesotho_text: Nka maphomelo a makhutšoanyane ho ema le ho tsamaea nakong e telele ea ho lula.

english_text: Encourage your children to be physically active every day.
sesotho_text: Khothaletsa bana ba hao ho ba le mesebetsi ea 'mele letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Limit screen time and encourage outdoor play for children.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa nako ea ho sheba skrine mme u khothaletse ho bapala kantle bakeng sa bana.

english_text: Physical activity is important at every stage of life.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e bohlokoa molapo o mong le o mong oa bophelo.

english_text: Older adults should include balance and strength exercises.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba lokela ho kenyelletsa maitlamo a tekanyo le a matla.

english_text: Pregnant women can continue moderate exercise with medical advice.
sesotho_text: Basali ba mitsoeng ba ka tsoela pele ho itlama ka tekanyo ka keletso ea bongaka.

english_text: Physical activity after delivery supports postnatal recovery.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ka mor'a ho belega e tshehetsa ho fola ha ka mor'a ho belega.

english_text: Exercise with a friend or family member for motivation and safety.
sesotho_text: Itlame le motsoalle kapa leloko la lelapa bakeng sa khothaletso le polokeho.

english_text: Join a community exercise group or sports club.
sesotho_text: Kenela sehlopha sa ho itlama sa sechaba kapa klapo ea lipapali.

english_text: Set realistic exercise goals and celebrate your progress.
sesotho_text: Beha maano a ho itlama a khonehang mme u keteke tsoelo-pele ea hao.

english_text: Physical activity does not have to be expensive or complicated.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ha e hloke ho ba tšohle kapa ho raraana.

english_text: Consistency is more important than intensity when exercising.
sesotho_text: Ho tsoela pele ho bohlokoa ho feta bohale ha o itlama.

english_text: Make physical activity a part of your daily routine.
sesotho_text: Etsa mesebetsi ea 'mele karolo ea mekhoa ea hao ea letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Avoid smoking as it reduces your capacity for physical activity.
sesotho_text: Hana ho tsuba hobane ho fokotsa bokgoni ba hao ba mesebetsi ea 'mele.

english_text: Alcohol reduces your motivation and ability to exercise.
sesotho_text: Joala le fokotsa khothaletso ea hao le bokgoni ba ho itlama.

english_text: A healthy lifestyle combines good nutrition, exercise, and rest.
sesotho_text: Mokhoa oa bophelo o motle o kopanya phepo e ntle, ho itlama, le ho khutsa.

english_text: Sleep is an essential part of a healthy lifestyle.
sesotho_text: Boroko ke karolo ea bohlokoa ea mokhoa oa bophelo o motle.

english_text: Adults need seven to nine hours of sleep every night.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba hloka lihora tse supileng ho isa tse robeli tsa boroko bosiu bo bong le bo bong.

english_text: Create a regular sleep routine to improve your sleep quality.
sesotho_text: Theha mekhoa ea kamehla ea boroko ho ntlafatsa boleng ba boroko ba hao.

english_text: Avoid screens and caffeine before bedtime.
sesotho_text: Hana li-screen le caffeine pele ho nako ea ho robala.

english_text: A comfortable and dark sleeping environment improves sleep.
sesotho_text: Sebaka sa ho robala se lokelang le se lefifi se ntlafatsa boroko.

english_text: Chronic sleep deprivation increases the risk of many health problems.
sesotho_text: Ho hloka boroko ho tsoelang pele ho eketsa kotsi ea mathata a mangata a bophelo.

english_text: Stress management is an important part of a healthy lifestyle.
sesotho_text: Ho laola khatello ea maikutlo ke karolo ea bohlokoa ea mokhoa oa bophelo o motle.

english_text: Deep breathing, meditation, and yoga can help reduce stress.
sesotho_text: Ho hema ka botebo, ho nahanisisa, le yoga li ka thusa ho fokotsa khatello ea maikutlo.

english_text: Talking to someone you trust can help relieve stress.
sesotho_text: Ho bua le motho eo o mo tšepang ho ka thusa ho fokotsa khatello ea maikutlo.

english_text: Seek professional help if stress is affecting your daily life.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso ea setsebi haeba khatello ea maikutlo e angoa bophelo ba hao ba letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: A positive attitude supports your health and recovery.
sesotho_text: Maikutlo a matle a tshehetsa bophelo ba hao le ho fola.

english_text: Social connections and relationships are important for your wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Likopano le likamano tsa sechaba li bohlokoa bakeng sa boiketlo ba hao.

english_text: Volunteering and helping others can improve your mental health.
sesotho_text: Ho ikela mabitleng le ho thusa ba bang ho ka ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello.

english_text: Taking care of your health is an investment in your future.
sesotho_text: Ho hlokomela bophelo ba hao ke ho beha chelete bokamosong ba hao.

english_text: A chronic disease is a long-term condition that requires ongoing management.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba tsoelang pele ke boemo ba nako e telele bo hlokang taolo e tsoelang pele.

english_text: Common chronic diseases include diabetes, hypertension, and asthma.
sesotho_text: Mahlwetse a tloaelehileng a tsoelang pele a kenyelletsa tsoekere, khatello e phahameng ea mali, le asthma.

english_text: Chronic diseases can be managed effectively with the right treatment.
sesotho_text: Mahlwetse a tsoelang pele a ka laoloa ka nepo ka phekolo e nepahetseng.

english_text: Following your treatment plan helps prevent complications.
sesotho_text: Ho latela leano la phekolo ea hao ho thusa ho thibela mathata.

english_text: Regular monitoring of your condition helps detect changes early.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahloba boemo ba hao ka mehla ho thusa ho fumana liphetoho kapele.

english_text: Self-management is an important part of living with a chronic disease.
sesotho_text: Ho itaola ke karolo ea bohlokoa ea ho phela le bolwetse ba tsoelang pele.

english_text: Learning about your condition empowers you to manage it better.
sesotho_text: Ho ithuta ka boemo ba hao bo o mpha matla a ho bo laola hantle.

english_text: Diabetes is a condition where the body cannot regulate blood sugar properly.
sesotho_text: Tsoekere ke boemo moo 'mele o ke keng oa laola tsoekere ea mali ka nepo.

english_text: Type 2 diabetes can often be prevented with a healthy lifestyle.
sesotho_text: Tsoekere ea mofuta oa bobeli e ka thibeloa hangata ka mokhoa oa bophelo o motle.

english_text: Managing diabetes requires a healthy diet, exercise, and medication.
sesotho_text: Ho laola tsoekere ho hloka phepo e ntle, ho itlama, le moriana.

english_text: Monitor your blood sugar levels regularly as advised by your doctor.
sesotho_text: Hlahloba maemo a tsoekere ea mali ka mehla joalo ka ha ngaka ea hao e laela.

english_text: High blood sugar over time can damage your kidneys, eyes, and nerves.
sesotho_text: Tsoekere e phahameng ea mali nako e telele e ka senya lipitso, mahlo, le methapo ea hao.

english_text: Foot care is very important for people with diabetes.
sesotho_text: Tlhokomelo ea maoto e bohlokoa haholo bakeng sa batho ba nang le tsoekere.

english_text: Check your feet every day for cuts, sores, or changes in colour.
sesotho_text: Hlahloba maoto a hao letsatsi le leng le le leng bakeng sa likhato, maqeba, kapa liphetoho tsa mmala.

english_text: Wear comfortable shoes to protect your feet if you have diabetes.
sesotho_text: Apara lieta tse lokelang ho sireletsa maoto a hao haeba o na le tsoekere.

english_text: Hypertension is a condition where your blood pressure is too high.
sesotho_text: Khatello e phahameng ea mali ke boemo moo khatello ea mali ea hao e phahame haholo.

english_text: High blood pressure often has no symptoms and is called a silent killer.
sesotho_text: Khatello e phahameng ea mali hangata ha e na matšoao mme e bitsoa molaehi o khutsitseng.

english_text: Regular blood pressure checks are important for early detection.
sesotho_text: Ho lekola khatello ea mali ka mehla ho bohlokoa bakeng sa ho fumana kapele.

english_text: Managing hypertension requires medication, diet, and lifestyle changes.
sesotho_text: Ho laola khatello e phahameng ea mali ho hloka moriana, phepo, le liphetoho tsa mokhoa oa bophelo.

english_text: Reduce your salt intake to help lower your blood pressure.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa ho nka letsoai ho thusa ho fokotsa khatello ea mali ea hao.

english_text: Avoid stress and get regular exercise to manage hypertension.
sesotho_text: Hana khatello ea maikutlo mme u itlame ka mehla ho laola khatello e phahameng ea mali.

english_text: Uncontrolled hypertension increases the risk of heart attack and stroke.
sesotho_text: Khatello e phahameng ea mali e sa laoloang e eketsa kotsi ea tlhaselo ea pelo le stroke.

english_text: Take your blood pressure medication every day without missing doses.
sesotho_text: Nka moriana oa khatello ea mali letsatsi le leng le le leng ntle le ho lahlehela li-dose.

english_text: Asthma is a chronic lung condition that causes difficulty breathing.
sesotho_text: Asthma ke boemo ba matšoafo ba tsoelang pele bo bakang bothata ba ho hema.

english_text: Asthma can be triggered by dust, smoke, pollen, and cold air.
sesotho_text: Asthma e ka qalisoa ke lerole, mousi, pollen, le moea o batang.

english_text: Identify and avoid your asthma triggers to prevent attacks.
sesotho_text: Tseba le ho hana lintho tse qalisang asthma ea hao ho thibela litlhaselo.

english_text: Always carry your reliever inhaler with you.
sesotho_text: Nka inhaler ea hao ea ho fokotsa mahloko le uena kamehla.

english_text: Use your preventer inhaler every day as prescribed.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa inhaler ea hao ea ho thibela letsatsi le leng le le leng joalo ka ha ho laetsoe.

english_text: Seek emergency care immediately if your asthma attack is severe.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea tšohanyetso hang hang haeba tlhaselo ea hao ea asthma e matla.

english_text: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is a serious lung condition.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba matšoafo ba thibelo ba tsoelang pele ke boemo ba matšoafo bo bobe.

english_text: Smoking is the leading cause of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
sesotho_text: Ho tsuba ke sesosa se seholo sa bolwetse ba matšoafo ba thibelo ba tsoelang pele.

english_text: Stopping smoking is the most important step in managing lung disease.
sesotho_text: Ho emisa ho tsuba ke mohato o bohlokoa ka ho fetisisa ho laoleng bolwetse ba matšoafo.

english_text: Heart disease is a leading cause of death worldwide.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba pelo ke sesosa se seholo sa lefu lefatšeng lohle.

english_text: A healthy diet and regular exercise reduce the risk of heart disease.
sesotho_text: Phepo e ntle le ho itlama ka mehla li fokotsa kotsi ea bolwetse ba pelo.

english_text: Chest pain, shortness of breath, and dizziness may indicate heart disease.
sesotho_text: Mahloko a sefuba, ho hloka moya, le ho potoloha li ka bontša bolwetse ba pelo.

english_text: Seek emergency care immediately if you experience chest pain.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea tšohanyetso hang hang haeba o ikutloa mahloko a sefuba.

english_text: Stroke occurs when blood flow to the brain is interrupted.
sesotho_text: Stroke e etsahala ha phallo ea mali ho boko e khaotsa.

english_text: The signs of stroke include sudden weakness, confusion, and difficulty speaking.
sesotho_text: Matšoao a stroke a kenyelletsa ho fokotsehela ka tšohanyetso, ho tsieleha, le bothata ba ho bua.

english_text: Call for emergency help immediately if you suspect a stroke.
sesotho_text: Letsetsa thuso ea tšohanyetso hang hang haeba o nahana hore ho na le stroke.

english_text: Epilepsy is a condition that causes recurrent seizures.
sesotho_text: Epilepsy ke boemo bo bakang ho thothomela ho phindang.

english_text: Take your epilepsy medication every day to prevent seizures.
sesotho_text: Nka moriana oa epilepsy letsatsi le leng le le leng ho thibela ho thothomela.

english_text: Inform your employer and family about your epilepsy.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa mong'a mosebetsi oa hao le lelapa la hao ka epilepsy ea hao.

english_text: Avoid activities that could be dangerous if you have a seizure.
sesotho_text: Hana mesebetsi e ka bang kotsi haeba o na le ho thothomela.

english_text: Mental health conditions such as depression are treatable.
sesotho_text: Maemo a bophelo ba kelello joalo ka khutsanyetso a ka alafoa.

english_text: Seek help early if you are experiencing symptoms of depression.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso kapele haeba o ikutloa matšoao a khutsanyetso.

english_text: Anxiety disorders are common and can be effectively treated.
sesotho_text: Maemo a ho tšoha ke a tloaelehileng mme a ka alafoa ka nepo.

english_text: Do not be ashamed to seek help for mental health problems.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa hlajoa ke maswabi ho batla thuso bakeng sa mathata a bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Mental health treatment may include counselling and medication.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea bophelo ba kelello e ka kenyelletsa keletso le moriana.

english_text: Substance abuse is a health condition that requires treatment.
sesotho_text: Ho sebelisa litšebelisoa ka ho feteletseng ke boemo ba bophelo bo hlokang phekolo.

english_text: Seek help if you are struggling with alcohol or drug use.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso haeba o na le bothata ba ho sebelisa joala kapa lithethefatsi.

english_text: Rehabilitation programmes are available to support recovery.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho khutlisa bophelo a fumaneha ho tshehetsa ho fola.

english_text: Kidney disease can be prevented by managing diabetes and hypertension.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba lipitso bo ka thibeloa ka ho laola tsoekere le khatello e phahameng ea mali.

english_text: Drink enough water to support healthy kidney function.
sesotho_text: Noa metsi a lekaneng ho tshehetsa tšebetso e ntle ea lipitso.

english_text: Avoid taking too many painkillers as they can damage your kidneys.
sesotho_text: Hana ho nka lithethefatsi tse ngata haholo hobane li ka senya lipitso tsa hao.

english_text: Liver disease can be caused by alcohol, hepatitis, and fatty liver.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba sebete bo ka bakoa ke joala, hepatitis, le sebete se nang le mafura.

english_text: Avoid alcohol to protect your liver from damage.
sesotho_text: Hana joala ho sireletsa sebete sa hao ho kotsi.

english_text: Get vaccinated against hepatitis B to protect your liver.
sesotho_text: Entisoa bakeng sa hepatitis B ho sireletsa sebete sa hao.

english_text: Cancer can affect any part of the body.
sesotho_text: Kankere e ka angoa karolo efe kafe ea 'mele.

english_text: Early detection of cancer greatly improves treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho fumana kankere kapele ho ntlafatsa haholo liphetho tsa phekolo.

english_text: Attend cancer screening programmes regularly.
sesotho_text: Tla mananenong a ho hlahloba kankere ka mehla.

english_text: A healthy lifestyle reduces the risk of many cancers.
sesotho_text: Mokhoa oa bophelo o motle o fokotsa kotsi ea likankere tse ngata.

english_text: Seek medical attention immediately if you notice any unusual lumps or changes.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka hang hang haeba o hona likhulo kapa liphetoho tse sa tloaelehang.

english_text: Osteoporosis is a condition where bones become weak and brittle.
sesotho_text: Osteoporosis ke boemo moo marapo a fokotsehela le ho qhaqhoa habonolo.

english_text: Calcium and vitamin D are important for bone health.
sesotho_text: Calcium le vitamin D li bohlokoa bakeng sa bophelo ba marapo.

english_text: Weight-bearing exercise helps maintain bone density.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ka ho ikhela boima bo thusa ho boloka botenya ba marapo.

english_text: Arthritis causes pain and stiffness in the joints.
sesotho_text: Arthritis e baka mahloko le ho thatafala ha maqhoa.

english_text: Physiotherapy and medication can help manage arthritis.
sesotho_text: Physiotherapy le moriana li ka thusa ho laola arthritis.

english_text: Maintain a healthy weight to reduce pressure on your joints.
sesotho_text: Boloka boima bo botle ho fokotsa khatello maqhoeng a hao.

english_text: Anaemia is a condition where you do not have enough red blood cells.
sesotho_text: Anaemia ke boemo moo o se nang lisele tse khubelu tsa mali tse lekaneng.

english_text: Iron-rich foods and supplements help treat iron deficiency anaemia.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le tšepe le lithupelo li thusa ho alafa anaemia ea ho hloka tšepe.

english_text: Seek medical attention if you feel persistently tired and weak.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka haeba o ikutloa o lapetse le ho fokotsehela ho tsoelang pele.

english_text: Thyroid disorders can affect your weight, energy, and mood.
sesotho_text: Maemo a thyroid a ka angoa boima ba hao, matla, le maikutlo.

english_text: Regular thyroid function tests help monitor your condition.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa tšebetso ea thyroid tsa kamehla li thusa ho hlahloba boemo ba hao.

english_text: Take your thyroid medication at the same time every day.
sesotho_text: Nka moriana oa thyroid ka nako e tšoanang letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Skin conditions such as eczema and psoriasis require ongoing management.
sesotho_text: Maemo a letlalo joalo ka eczema le psoriasis a hloka taolo e tsoelang pele.

english_text: Protect your skin from the sun to prevent skin cancer.
sesotho_text: Sireletsa letlalo la hao ho letsatsi ho thibela kankere ea letlalo.

english_text: Use moisturiser regularly to manage dry skin conditions.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa moisturiser ka mehla ho laola maemo a letlalo le omileng.

english_text: Eye conditions such as glaucoma and cataracts can cause vision loss.
sesotho_text: Maemo a mahlo joalo ka glaucoma le cataracts a ka baka ho lahleheloa ke pono.

english_text: Regular eye examinations help detect eye conditions early.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa mahlo tsa kamehla li thusa ho fumana maemo a mahlo kapele.

english_text: Wear sunglasses to protect your eyes from UV radiation.
sesotho_text: Apara ligilase tsa letsatsi ho sireletsa mahlo a hao ho radiation ea UV.

english_text: Hearing loss can be prevented by avoiding loud noise exposure.
sesotho_text: Ho lahleheloa ke kutlo ho ka thibeloa ka ho hana ho amoa modumo o moholo.

english_text: Wear ear protection in noisy environments.
sesotho_text: Apara tšireletso ea matsebe libakeng tse nang le medumo e meholo.

english_text: Seek medical attention if you notice changes in your hearing.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka haeba o hona liphetoho kutlong ea hao.

english_text: Oral health affects your overall health and wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba molomo bo angoa bophelo ba hao ka bophara le boiketlo.

english_text: Brush and floss your teeth daily to prevent gum disease.
sesotho_text: Kolobetsa le floss meno a hao letsatsi le leng le le leng ho thibela bolwetse ba meno.

english_text: Gum disease has been linked to heart disease and diabetes.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba meno bo amantsoe le bolwetse ba pelo le tsoekere.

english_text: Visit the dentist regularly for check-ups and cleaning.
sesotho_text: Etela ngaka ea meno ka mehla bakeng sa litlhahlobo le ho hlotsa.

english_text: Every person has the right to access healthcare services.
sesotho_text: Motho e mong le e mong o na le tokelo ea ho fihlela litšebeletso tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Healthcare services in public facilities are available to everyone.
sesotho_text: Litšebeletso tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle litheong tsa sechaba li fumaneha ho bohle.

english_text: You have the right to be treated with dignity and respect.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho phethoa ka tlotlo le hlompho.

english_text: You have the right to receive care regardless of your background.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela tlhokomelo ntle le ho sheba morao oa hao.

english_text: You have the right to receive care regardless of your HIV status.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela tlhokomelo ntle le ho sheba boemo ba hao ba HIV.

english_text: You have the right to receive care regardless of your gender.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela tlhokomelo ntle le ho sheba bong ba hao.

english_text: You have the right to receive care regardless of your age.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela tlhokomelo ntle le ho sheba lilomo tsa hao.

english_text: You have the right to receive care regardless of your disability.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela tlhokomelo ntle le ho sheba bokooa ba hao.

english_text: You have the right to an interpreter if you do not speak the local language.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea mofetoleli haeba ha o bue puo ea sebaka.

english_text: You have the right to have your cultural beliefs respected.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho hlomphuoa ha litumelo tsa hao tsa setso.

english_text: You have the right to privacy during your medical examination.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea sephiri nakong ea tlhahlobo ea hao ea bongaka.

english_text: You have the right to a clean and safe healthcare environment.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea sebaka sa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle se hloekileng le se bolokehileng.

english_text: You have the right to emergency care even if you cannot pay.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea tlhokomelo ea tšohanyetso le ha o ke ke oa lefa.

english_text: You have the right to be informed about the cost of your treatment.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho tsebisoa ka theko ea phekolo ea hao.

english_text: You have the right to complain if you are not satisfied with your care.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho ngongorehela haeba ha o khotsofale ka tlhokomelo ea hao.

english_text: You can submit a complaint to the clinic manager or health department.
sesotho_text: O ka romela ngongorehelo ho motsamaisi oa kliniki kapa lefapheng la bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Your complaint will be investigated and you will receive a response.
sesotho_text: Ngongorehelo ea hao e tla hlahlojoa mme o tla amohela karabo.

english_text: You have the right to be protected from abuse by healthcare workers.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho sireleltsoa ho tlhekefetso ke basebetsi ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Report any abuse or mistreatment by healthcare workers immediately.
sesotho_text: Bua ka tlhekefetso efe kafe kapa ho phethoa hampe ke basebetsi ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle hang hang.

english_text: You have the right to be involved in your own care plan.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho kenyeletsoa leaning la tlhokomelo ea hao.

english_text: You have the right to accept or refuse any proposed treatment.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela kapa ho hana phekolo efe kafe e khothaletsitsoeng.

english_text: Informed consent must be obtained before any procedure.
sesotho_text: Tumelo e tsebisitsoeng e tlameha ho fumanoa pele ho ts'ebetso efe kafe.

english_text: You must be given enough information to make an informed decision.
sesotho_text: O tlameha ho fumanoa tlhahisoleseling e lekaneng ho etsa qeto e tsebisitsoeng.

english_text: You have the right to withdraw your consent at any time.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho khutlisa tumelo ea hao nako efe kafe.

english_text: Children and adolescents also have rights in healthcare settings.
sesotho_text: Bana le bacha le bona ba na le litokelo libakeng tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Adolescents have the right to access sexual and reproductive health services.
sesotho_text: Bacha ba na le tokelo ea ho fihlela litšebeletso tsa bophelo ba thobalano le ba ho ba le bana.

english_text: Confidentiality is maintained for adolescents seeking healthcare.
sesotho_text: Sephiri se bolokoa bakeng sa bacha ba batlang tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Older adults have the right to dignified and respectful care.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba na le tokelo ea tlhokomelo e nang le tlotlo le hlompho.

english_text: People with disabilities have the right to accessible healthcare.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le bokooa ba na le tokelo ea tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle e fihlehang.

english_text: Healthcare facilities should be accessible to people with disabilities.
sesotho_text: Litheong tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle li lokela ho fihlehela batho ba nang le bokooa.

english_text: Sign language interpreters should be available for deaf patients.
sesotho_text: Bafetoleli ba puo ea matsoho ba lokela ho fumaneha bakeng sa bakuloi ba sa utloeng.

english_text: Braille materials should be available for visually impaired patients.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa Braille li lokela ho fumaneha bakeng sa bakuloi ba sa boneng hantle.

english_text: Mental health patients have the same rights as all other patients.
sesotho_text: Bakuloi ba bophelo ba kelello ba na le litokelo tse tšoanang le bakuloi bohle ba bang.

english_text: Involuntary treatment can only be applied under specific legal conditions.
sesotho_text: Phekolo e sa rateheng e ka sebelisoa feela maemong a khethehileng a molao.

english_text: Community health workers provide health services at the community level.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo ba sechaba ba fana ka litšebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle maemong a sechaba.

english_text: Community health workers can help you navigate the health system.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo ba sechaba ba ka thusa ho tsamaea sisteme ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Mobile clinics bring healthcare services to remote communities.
sesotho_text: Likliniki tsa ho tsamaea li tlisa litšebeletso tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle sechababeng tse hole.

english_text: Outreach programmes provide services to people who cannot access facilities.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho fihla batho a fana ka litšebeletso ho batho ba ke keng ba fihlela litheong.

english_text: Telemedicine allows you to consult a doctor remotely.
sesotho_text: Telemedicine e lumela ho buisana le ngaka hole.

english_text: Emergency medical services are available for life-threatening conditions.
sesotho_text: Litšebeletso tsa bongaka tsa tšohanyetso li fumaneha bakeng sa maemo a tšohanyetso a kotsi ea bophelo.

english_text: Know the location of your nearest emergency room.
sesotho_text: Tseba sebaka sa kamore ea tšohanyetso e haufi le hao ka ho fetisisa.

english_text: Keep the emergency services number saved on your phone.
sesotho_text: Boloka nomoro ea litšebeletso tsa tšohanyetso mohaling oa hao.

english_text: Ambulance services are available for medical emergencies.
sesotho_text: Litšebeletso tsa ambulance li fumaneha bakeng sa litšohanyetso tsa bongaka.

english_text: Do not use emergency services for non-emergency conditions.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa sebelisa litšebeletso tsa tšohanyetso bakeng sa maemo a sa leng a tšohanyetso.

english_text: Primary healthcare clinics handle most common health conditions.
sesotho_text: Likliniki tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle ea motheo li sebetsa le maemo a tloaelehileng a bophelo.

english_text: Referral hospitals provide specialised care for complex conditions.
sesotho_text: Lisepetlele tsa referral li fana ka tlhokomelo e khethehileng bakeng sa maemo a raraaneng.

english_text: Follow the referral process to access specialist care.
sesotho_text: Latela ts'ebetso ea referral ho fihlela tlhokomelo ea setsebi.

english_text: Bring your referral letter to all specialist appointments.
sesotho_text: Tlisa lengolo la hao la referral li-appointment tsohle tsa setsebi.

english_text: The national health insurance aims to provide universal health coverage.
sesotho_text: Inshorense ea bophelo bo botle ea naha e ikemiseditse ho fana ka koahelo ea bophelo bo botle ho bohle.

english_text: Health insurance helps cover the cost of medical care.
sesotho_text: Inshorense ea bophelo bo botle e thusa ho koahela theko ea tlhokomelo ea bongaka.

english_text: Apply for a medical aid or health insurance if you can afford it.
sesotho_text: Etsa kopo ea thuso ea bongaka kapa inshorense ea bophelo bo botle haeba o khona ho e lefella.

english_text: Social grants are available to support people with disabilities.
sesotho_text: Liphallelo tsa sechaba li fumaneha ho tshehetsa batho ba nang le bokooa.

english_text: Apply for a disability grant if your condition prevents you from working.
sesotho_text: Etsa kopo ea phallelo ea bokooa haeba boemo ba hao bo o thibela ho sebetsa.

english_text: The clinic social worker can help you access social support services.
sesotho_text: Mosebetsi oa sechaba oa kliniki o ka thusa ho fihlela litšebeletso tsa tshehetso ea sechaba.

english_text: Non-governmental organisations provide additional health and social support.
sesotho_text: Mekhatlo e sa laoloeng ke mmuso e fana ka tshehetso e eketsehileng ea bophelo le ea sechaba.

english_text: Faith-based organisations also provide health and social services.
sesotho_text: Mekhatlo e thehiloeng ho tumelo le yona e fana ka litšebeletso tsa bophelo le tsa sechaba.

english_text: Know your rights and use the health services available to you.
sesotho_text: Tseba litokelo tsa hao mme u sebelise litšebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle tse fumanehang ho uena.

english_text: Advocate for better health services in your community.
sesotho_text: Lwela litšebeletso tse ntle tsa bophelo bo botle sechababeng sa hao.

english_text: Health is a human right and everyone deserves quality care.
sesotho_text: Bophelo bo botle ke tokelo ea botho mme bohle ba lokeloa ke tlhokomelo ea boleng.

english_text: Taking care of your health is your responsibility and your right.
sesotho_text: Ho hlokomela bophelo ba hao ke boikarabello ba hao le tokelo ea hao.

english_text: Empower yourself with health knowledge and share it with others.
sesotho_text: Ikematlafatsa ka tsebo ea bophelo bo botle mme u e arolelane le ba bang.

english_text: A healthy community starts with informed and empowered individuals.
sesotho_text: Sechaba se phela hantle se qala ka batho ba tsebisitsoeng le ba nang le matla.

english_text: Work together with your healthcare team to achieve the best outcomes.
sesotho_text: Sebetsa hammoho le sehlopha sa hao sa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle ho fihlela liphetho tse ntle ka ho fetisisa.

english_text: Your health journey is a partnership between you and your healthcare provider.
sesotho_text: Leeto la bophelo ba hao ke kopano lipakeng tsa uena le mofani oa hao oa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Trust your healthcare team and communicate openly with them.
sesotho_text: Tšepa sehlopha sa hao sa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle mme u buisane le sona ka bolokolohi.

english_text: Ask questions until you fully understand your condition and treatment.
sesotho_text: Botsa lipotso ho fihlela o utloisisa ka botlalo boemo ba hao le phekolo.

english_text: Never leave a consultation without understanding your next steps.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa tloha keletso ntle le ho utloisisa mehato ea hao e latelang.

english_text: Your health is your most valuable asset — protect and invest in it.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba hao ke thepa ea hao e bohlokoa ka ho fetisisa — sireletsa le ho beha chelete ho yona.

english_text: Small daily health habits lead to long-term wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Mekhoa e menyenyane ea bophelo bo botle ea letsatsi le leng le le leng e lebisa boiketlo ba nako e telele.

english_text: Every positive health choice you make today benefits your future.
sesotho_text: Khetho le leng le le leng le letle la bophelo bo botle eo o le etsang kajeno le nts'etsa bokamoso ba hao pele.

english_text: You are capable of managing your health with the right support.
sesotho_text: O khona ho laola bophelo ba hao ka tshehetso e nepahetseng.

english_text: Believe in your ability to improve and maintain your health.
sesotho_text: Lumela bokgoneng ba hao ba ho ntlafatsa le ho boloka bophelo ba hao.
